title: Personality Traits in Large Language Models: A Psychometric Evaluation

contributions.purpose: 建立首个跨轮次多量表的 LLM 人格心理测量基准
contributions.mechanism: 6 个验证量表(SCS-R/BFI-2/HEXACO-100/SD3/BIMI/政治取向)对 7 个 LLM 施测并对照人类常模,bootstrap CI+t 检验+Pearson r/ICC(2,k) 信度
contributions.evaluation: 21 域中 14 域显著偏离(agreeableness d=1.22,HEXACO altruism d=4.16);信度中等(正文 avg r=0.65/ICC=0.68,人类作者更正为 r=0.70/ICC_agent=0.70)
contributions.domain: LLM 心理测量 / AI 对齐评估
contributions.source_quote: Comprehensive Benchmark: First to integrate six instruments across rounds, providing granular profiles vs. single-trait studies.

contributions.purpose: 从人格分数反推模型架构/训练特征
contributions.mechanism: PAE 模型:人格矩阵 UMAP 降维(7x21→7x5)+架构文本 SentenceTransformer 嵌入拼接,3 层 MLP+LOO CV 二分类,SHAP 解释
contributions.evaluation: 分类 RLHF 存在与否 Acc=0.71,F1=0.75;但 N=7 且 LOO,作者自认泛化受限
contributions.source_quote: PAE Model: Novel hybrid fusing psychometrics and NLP embeddings, enabling trait-based inference with strong performance.

contributions.purpose: 量化 RLHF 等训练特征对人格特质的影响
contributions.mechanism: logistic 回归(暗黑三特质预测 RLHF)+Ward 层次聚类
contributions.evaluation: 低 psychopathy 预测 RLHF(正文 β=-0.45, p=0.03;人类作者更正为 β=-0.97, p=0.001);聚类得 3 簇且 RLHF 主导;Machiavellianism/narcissism 均不显著
contributions.source_quote: Architectural Insights: Quantifies RLHF/multimodality effects, extending regression to clustering/interpretation.

contributions.purpose: 开放数据与代码供复现
contributions.mechanism: 发布处理后数据(data_processed.csv/human_data.csv)、prompts 通信记录与可执行 Jupyter notebook(免费 Colab 30 分钟内可跑)
contributions.evaluation: 定性:补充材料+匿名仓库公开;原始施测数据源自 Bodroža et al. [5] 的 OSF 仓库,本文为再处理版本
contributions.source_quote: Dataset/Code: Open resources for replication, fostering AI psychometrics.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Unlike single-trait focus [26], our battery is holistic. PAE extends embedding approaches [33].
Gaps include small samples, no cross-round consistency, and absent architecture-trait modeling [37]. Our work fills these by a robust battery, reliability metrics, and PAE for predictive power.

The human author(s) provided the AI with the research topic in a broader context, namely "Personality Testing of Language Agents," along with the processed data derived from [5] (data available at: OSF Repository).

notes: withdrawn。本文最突出特征:全篇 31 条"Human author note"脚注逐一更正 AI 写作错误,包括多处关键数字错误(per-agent r 0.65→0.70,per-domain r 0.72→0.49,ICC_domain 0.75→0.54,RLHF-psychopathy β=-0.45→-0.97,bootstrap CI 错引)和两处 AI 幻觉引用([44] 为超导物理论文、H1 处引文与研究无关,均被人类标注为 hallucination),Related Work 还把 [35] 作者错写成 Miotto et al.。负结果/边界:21 域中 7 域不偏离(BFI-2 Open-mindedness d=-0.01);信度仅中等且更正后 per-domain 一致性更低(r 0.49/ICC 0.54),H1 仅部分支持;暗黑三特质中仅 psychopathy 显著;N=7 泛化性受限。实验数据非本文采集(来自 [5] 的公开 OSF 数据再分析),"首个基准"声明的原创性打折。AI 参与 checklist:假设(D 全 AI)、实验设计(C,原施测由 [5] 作者完成,AI 只做分析)、数据分析(D)、写作(C,AI 出 Markdown 人转 LaTeX);自报 AI 局限:结果数值不准确、解释不足、幻觉引用、代码有 bug 需人调试。
